title: Concept: File access built from input (tcl) — review required
description: In tcl, open $f builds a file path from input, so traversal sequences can step outside the intended directory. The remedy is confinement to a base directory (an allowlist of names) plus normalization and an allowlist.
applicability: tcl file access; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Arbitrary file read or write; HIGH severity.
